bluf: SocialSEO is a Colorado Springs digital marketing firm, founded in 1996 by the record, that sells SEO plus paid search, social, Amazon, video and email to small businesses. Its status is uncertain: the homepage banner promotes Intero, footer social links point to Intero Digital accounts, several case study URLs now read as Intero Digital results, and no sitemap content has changed since June 2025. It is likely, moderate confidence, that the brand is being folded into Intero Digital, though the relationship is not stated. A rival should know its clients, whoever they are, sit in a transition.
doing:
SocialSEO positions as a Colorado Springs digital marketing firm selling local and national SEO, paid search, social, Amazon, video and email to growing businesses. Decoded: a generalist shop for small companies, with search in the brand name and a long menu behind it. The headline claim cites an UpCity ranking as the top digital marketing firm in America, and its showcase pages carry award titles such as "Voted Best Amazon Company", dated 2022.

The sold mix has no lead line. SEO is the one core line, at score 2: SEO sits in the brand name and the meta (local and national SEO), with SEO and Enterprise SEO pages and an SEO case page. CRO, content and digital PR, creator and influencer, email and CRM, local, paid search, paid social, retail media and web each score 1 with no evidence note; AI search, AI automation, B2B, data and measurement and programmatic score 0; breadth reads 10. The services run from SEO Services and SEM Services to Amazon Marketing, Influencer Marketing, Video Production and Omnichannel Marketing. The record lists no proprietary product and no partner.

AI posture: the record is silent. No AI claim, no AI service, no llms.txt; the sitemap holds 3 AI URLs.

Moves: none dated. The dated artifacts are old or borrowed: showcase pages dated 2022-03-21 and 2022-09-19, case study lastmod stamps from 2021-08-23 to 2023-01-06, and the SEO, social media, SEM, graphic design and video case study URLs now returning a page titled "Intero Digital Results", dated 2026-09-04, whose excerpt points readers to Intero Digital case studies. The status note adds the Intero banner, the Intero Digital footer links and no sitemap change since June 2025. Pricing: the record is silent. Conspicuously absent for a live agency: any ad, any job, any named client and any sitemap URL updated in 365 days.
clients:
SocialSEO sells to SMB clients, growing businesses in its own words, from a single office in Colorado Springs, CO. The record lists its verticals as real estate, ecommerce and pet products, restaurants, coaching and consulting, automotive parts and outdoor sports equipment, all small business categories with no account attached.

The needs read holds 0 clients: nothing observed, nothing named only, nothing shared with another tracked agency. The deepen pass counts 9 case studies, yet none names a client. The showcase pages are award titles, "Voted Best Amazon Company", "Voted Best SMA Company", "Voted Best Omni Company" and "Voted Best Content Company", dated 2022-03-21 and 2022-09-19, and the SEO, social media, SEM, graphic design and video pages now carry the title "Intero Digital Results" and an excerpt about Intero Digital case studies. In the record, the work the brand once described carries either no client name or another company's name.

What the base needs next is inferred from the sold mix, because no client signal exists: SEO first, then paid search and social for small businesses. The Horus read marks SocialSEO most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out) through SEO, Paid Search and Paid Social, and to KJ9 (measurement gets worse before it gets better) through SEO. It is likely, low confidence, that SMB clients buying SEO hours from this brand face both a service transition and a category under pressure, and a roughly even chance they are already shopping. Its one tailwind of weight, KJ8 (human provenance becomes a distribution signal), runs through Creator & Influencer, a line scored 1 with no evidence note.

openings:
The strongest opening is the transition. The record shows a live SocialSEO site whose banner promotes Intero, whose footer links point to Intero Digital accounts, whose case study URLs now read as Intero Digital results, and whose sitemap has not changed since June 2025. It is likely, moderate confidence, that its SMB clients are being moved or left behind, and clients in a transition answer the phone. Falsifier: new SocialSEO branded content, ads or case studies in the next compile, or a stated relationship that keeps the brand independent.

Price is the second lever: displacement reads 72.2 on the Monsoon read, so it is likely, low confidence given the read is inferred, that the book buys on price and a lower cost rival can undercut its SEO and paid search lines. With 0 clients on record, the verticals are the targets: real estate, restaurants, ecommerce and pet products, automotive parts.

It shows no feed, schema or entity work (P2 absent), no AI search line and no public pricing (P5 unknown): a transparent SEO offer with AI visibility built in is likely to undercut it with the small businesses it serves.
